nonblocking.detail: This PASS approves the inspected source path only. Actual CUDA state/output parity, PF autograd, the three real-update smokes, fresh50 completion, frozen evaluations, and installed-GT CPU recount have not been executed by this reviewer. The launcher explicitly blocks fresh50 until the tensor contract and all three smokes pass.

The normalized pair-distance objective is rotation invariant and does not establish common identity orientation, gate calibration, causal synergy, or superiority. Evaluate the real full11-minus-base00 changes, Rank1 harm/rescue and matched controls after the full fixed trial, as the plan requires.

The review has fresh context but remains same-family/provisional. The independent CPU metric audit is a separate numerical implementation against installed GT; it is not independent external model acceptance.

checks.findings: The M2 subclass calls the original_mean constructor and adds only non-parameter bookkeeping attributes. Its only training change is +0.1 times SmoothL1 of normalized off-diagonal pair distances. Each source/prediction feature is L2 normalized in FP32; its N*(N-1) non-diagonal distances are divided by their own mean. Ordered symmetric pairs give the same average loss as unique unordered pairs. No new head, optimizer group, feature dimension, pooling rule, gate, or classifier is introduced.

The hook is installed on the production frequency_projection and receives the actual already-conditioned/routed frequency input and that same module output in full fuse. This is the F_pre -> F_post outlet diagnosed by the frozen utility code, not F_aux or a copied projection. reference.detach() stops all target-distance gradients. Student gradients traverse the real PF and may also reach its upstream student input; the encoder is not falsely described as frozen. No unavailable-modality teacher is created.

The successful full training fuse installs one hook, captures one PF invocation, removes it before returning and before controlled 10/01 fuse calls, and stores one loss. Measurement requires training, nonpartial, both M/F active and positive weight. Full forward clears stale loss and adds it exactly once to the existing odd auxiliary-loss tail. partial=True returns the unchanged score/feature pair; 10/01 calls do not replace the full loss; eval and eval return_states add no relation term. A subsequent full call restores the flag and fresh loss. No exception recovery path is added; a failed forward remains a failed process.

For each of axis/frequency/twins, the runtime gate compares identical state keys and every initialized tensor against the original_mean M1 builder, then all four states for all seven availability sets (84 state comparisons total). It requires zero-weight full AMP training outputs to be exactly equal under restored RNG, finite nonzero aggregate autograd on actual PF parameters, stopped teacher targets, and B*(B-1) pairs. Parameter and trainable-parameter totals must match all three variants. A separate actual tensor check requires no teacher gradient and finite nonzero student gradient. This reviewer did not run these CUDA checks.

The wrapper calls the same training.step and only appends the relation audit fields. The training loop, sampler, augmentation streams, partial-set generator, CE/triplet/contribution weights, scheduler, public CLIP initialization and 50-epoch budget remain directly reused. B64/K4 and seed42 are retained. One full-view backward followed by one partial-view backward feeds one native GradScaler512 step. optimizer_updated uses the post-update scale versus the previous scale; batch attempts, actual updates and skips are recorded separately. Smoke consumes up to six distinct successive batches/partial sets until exactly three actual updates, verifies all active parameter gradients and strict reload in memory, and writes no weights.

The three completed original_mean M1 controls were read directly: each is MSVR310/seed42/fresh publicCLIP/50 epochs, 453 batch attempts and 453 optimizer updates with zero skips, 100263558 total and 100251270 trainable parameters, 5632 dimensions. Standard-library comparison confirmed all 453 epoch/step/names/partial_set rows match across the historical controls and every batch has 64 names. The final M2 audit requires each new sequence to match its historical control exactly. New relation operations consume no random draw. The launcher runs only the three new relation controls and never retrains the old controls.

One tensor contract on physical GPU2 must pass first. All three smokes must then finish with SMOKE_PASS, three actual updates, strict reload, weight0.1 and detached-target evidence. Only after all futures return and the preflight PASS is written are fresh50 jobs submitted. Two workers are used; GPU2 executes axis then twins serially, while GPU3 executes frequency. Each variant completes its training and frozen/state/utility stages before the next job on that device. The launch path has no rerun or fallback. The helper waits 240 seconds only when the selected physical GPU has >=500 MiB in use, uses device-restricted child environments, checks return codes and only cleans its own process group if needed.

Only development mAP selects the best checkpoint, with a strict > comparison retaining the earliest tie. The 50-epoch terminal reload is strict and checked against saved best metrics. The old CommonOutlet builder is valid for M2 evaluation because M2 adds no state keys or inference changes. Its best clean features must exactly reproduce the saved fresh50 features. All49 seven-by-seven query/gallery conditions use the same development GT/split and same-ID/same-scene exclusion; no official-test entry point is invoked.

Each trained model produces all49 full conditions, 294 six-state conditions and 392 eight-stage utility conditions. Three models therefore give 147 full, 882 state and 1176 utility conditions; the independent audit counts states+utility=2058, or 432180 rows at the historical 210 queries. Four-state controlled 10/01 behavior and base-private/shared blocks are inherited. The utility diagnostic captures production M/F/I projections, preserves the trained original_mean readout and exact arithmetic association, and requires reconstructed deployment/features and all49 deployed metrics/perquery rows to match prior frozen evaluation. F_aux/M_aux are the same source-available independent auxiliary representations; F_pre is routed F and F_post is the production PF output. The M2 wrapper changes only scope/learning metadata, with no recursive writer or tensor change.

The final auditor imports only stdlib and NumPy plus a NumPy/stdlib audit dependency; neither imports Torch or a model. It independently reconstructs MSVR310 dev records from installed vis filenames, verifies ni/th mates, filters fixed dev IDs and creates valid cross-scene queries. Each raw archive must exactly match this GT. A separate lexicographic ranking with gallery-row tie breaks recomputes AP, INP, ranks1/5/10/20, CMC1..50, query validity, camera/scene/identity groups and exact perquery exports. Same-ID/same-scene junk is excluded. Six-state audit additionally verifies contribution GT/arithmetic and perquery full11-versus00/M/F harm/rescue; utility audit recounts every stage and checks deployed against state11. Sampling and relation-pair/weight/stopgrad/finite fields are checked before a PASS. No actual M2 raw audit is claimed here.

Smoke uses an in-memory state-dict roundtrip. Fresh training writes only one best.pth per variant, overwritten only on improved dev mAP; it writes no initial/last checkpoint. New output directories must not exist. The final CPU audit requires exactly three .pth files and every name best.pth within the new campaign. No reviewed path deletes existing reference or current weights.

The deployer requires this source PASS with empty blockers and exact reviewed source/deployer hashes; verifies all 66 local sources; confirms the 60 old sources before mirroring only six new text sources to 2025/2026/2027 and rechecking all66. It launches only on 2026, after AST, selected physical2/3 free-memory, old M1 COMPLETE, exact prior independent-CPU-evidence SHA/PASS, input paths and free disk checks. It starts the new launcher exactly once, with fresh exclusive log/output guards and a dispatch-not-acceptance status. 2025/2027 receive no neural jobs. collect_results import has no top-level main execution; subprocess argv and SSH shlex quoting are appropriate for the fixed paths. No password, images or weight binaries are copied. Telemetry queries only index/memory; there is no temperature/power query or setting.
